crossRefs.note: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the…
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

parallels.note: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

translations.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
translations.bsb: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
translations.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
translations.asv: Glory ye in his holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
